product_one_liner.value: Lumilens designs and manufactures silicon-photonics optical interconnects—including pluggables, near-package optics and co-packaged optics—for hyperscalers building and scaling AI data-center compute infrastructure.

pricing_page.notes: The public site presents product and company information but no public pricing link or priced plans.

named_customers.notes: The company refers to an unnamed hyperscaler customer and a multi-billion-dollar customer agreement, but no qualifying page located in this review names at least two customers.

eng_blog.notes: The readable News & Insights index contains company/product, funding and media material, but does not show at least two engineer-authored build/architecture/infrastructure posts.

public_docs.notes: No public product documentation, developer portal or multi-article help center is linked from the public site.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live openings list contains many engineering, software, manufacturing and operations roles, but no title matching the specified AI/ML/data-science categories.

model_provider.notes: No public model or model-provider disclosure was located in the reviewed product, news, privacy or hiring material.

compliance_certs.notes: The public privacy/legal page contains security and compliance language but names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR or PCI DSS as a certification.

last_funding.notes: The announcement says the Series C raised more than $700 million; the schema requires a number, so the reported round amount is represented as 700000000.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series C announcement is dated August 6, 2026, within the 18-month window before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live openings list does not show an SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative or account-executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: Lumilens publicly announced its emergence from stealth and launch into production shipping on August 6, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small public leadership roster was readable, but it does not provide start dates and no dated join/leave announcement was located.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A live Business Process Manager posting names these enterprise systems/platforms in its technology experience requirements.
